structure_source: Table of contents of the SSO version 'Current version as at 20 Oct 2026' (latest amendment Act 2 of 2026, in force 16 Oct 2026), from a user-saved browser copy. Section numbers and headings only; retrieve provision text for every assessment.
guidelines: PDPC Advisory Guidelines on Key Concepts in the PDPA, revised 29 April 2026. Page numbers are from that revision's table of contents.

items.obligation: Whether the Act's data protection provisions apply
prompts: Is the subject data 'personal data' as defined, and is any of it business contact information?
Is the actor an organisation, a data intermediary processing on behalf of another under a written contract, or excluded?

items.obligation: Accountability: compliance, data protection officer, policies and practices
guidelines: Appointing a Data Protection Officer, p 151
prompts: Who is responsible for compliance, and are the required policies, practices and contact information in place?

items.obligation: Consent: obtaining, deemed consent, withdrawal and exceptions
guidelines: Exceptions to the Consent Obligation, p 60
prompts: For each collection, use and disclosure, what is the basis: consent, deemed consent, or an exception in the Schedules?
Can consent be withdrawn, and what happens when it is?
Are the purposes ones a reasonable person would consider appropriate in the circumstances, and limited to those notified?

guidelines: Providing notification through a Data Protection Policy, p 84
prompts: Are individuals told the purposes on or before collection, and is a contact for questions provided where required?

items.obligation: Access to and correction of personal data
guidelines: The Access and Correction Obligations, p 90
Response time frame for an access request, p 95
Obligation to correct personal data, p 106
prompts: Can access and correction requests be received, met within time, and refused only on a recorded exception?
Is reasonable effort made to keep data accurate and complete where it is used for decisions or disclosed?
What security arrangements protect the data, including data held by intermediaries?
When does retention stop serving the purpose, and how is data then deleted or anonymised?

items.obligation: Transfer of personal data outside Singapore
guidelines: Conditions for transfer of personal data overseas, p 123
prompts: Is data transferred or accessible outside Singapore, and on what basis is comparable protection ensured?

guidelines: The Data Breach Notification Obligation, p 130
Criteria for data breach notification, p 133
prompts: Is there a process to assess a suspected breach, decide notifiability, and notify within time?

items.obligation: Offences affecting personal data and anonymised information
guidelines: Part IV: Offences affecting personal data and anonymised information, p 156
prompts: Could individuals in the organisation disclose, misuse or re-identify data in a way the offence provisions address?

items.obligation: Do Not Call Registry: specified messages to Singapore telephone numbers
prompts: Does the activity send marketing messages to Singapore telephone numbers? The Key Concepts guidelines do not cover this; use PDPC's separate Do Not Call guidance.

items.obligation: Status of Part 6B, which section 4 refers to
prompts: Section 4 refers to Parts 6, 6A and 6B, but the table of contents for the version as at 20 Oct 2026 lists no Part 6B. Establish its status for the law-as-at date before relying on its absence.
